budget.failed_or_unpriced_calls: Keep full reservation charged until cost is reconciled; do not retry automatically.

budget_amendment: Explicit continuation: carry all four prior call charges into the same $25 total allowance; replace eight total calls with twelve total calls (eight new calls, four PR pairs). No reset of spending.
call_order: Order arms by SHA256(protocol ID, PR, arm) to avoid always sending one arm first. Cache confounding remains recorded.
cohort_rule: First four distinct non-draft PRs created after registration, with Go changes, ordered by PR number. Pin first observed ready head and merge base. Never replace based on classifier score or reviewer finding. Previously observed and experiment branches are excluded.
metrics: classifier inference and feature construction time separately
full/candidate reviewer findings and source-adjudicated omission-caused losses
name: classifier-value-v11
oversize: If either complete prompt exceeds 180000 bytes, record non-evaluable case, retain full review, make no paid calls for the pair, and do not substitute a favorable PR.
review_protocol: One no-tools Claude full-packet and one candidate-packet call per PR, isolated sessions. Frozen SVM scores every changed function locally. Unsupported units retained. Complete before/after code and required fallback context preserved. No gate on predicted reduction: retain-all PRs count toward utility.
stop_rule: Four eligible snapshots, twelve cumulative calls, exhausted $25 budget, or user stop. No retraining or threshold changes within cohort.
unit: Entire changed-file/declaration population, not sampled functions

utility_target.interpretation: Pilot evidence only: four pairs cannot establish defect recall or production safety. No automatic promotion.
